method: Visual inspection of front, reverse, edge and oblique engineering plots produced from the production loader meshes; plots omit photo texture pixels and use a solid framebuffer swatch. Not a WebGL or physical-fit acceptance.

items.observation: Circular optic centred over a distinct 37.5 mm PCB envelope; estimated neck and rear BOOT/RESET blocks remain visibly separate; no package geometry inferred from the flat back photograph.
Distinct 36.5 mm bare PCB envelope and neck; circular framebuffer is unobstructed. Neck/depth remain photo-based estimates.
48 mm front bezel and 44.2 mm cylindrical body; recessed 35.85 mm opening; 12.5 mm depth. Hidden assembly and wall thickness remain UNKNOWN/estimated.
48 mm front bezel and distinct 46 mm body, 33 mm opening and 11.5 mm depth; hidden assembly and ports remain unverified.

68 mm outer frame, central 48.96 mm square active area and four 62 mm mounting centres are coherent in front/reverse views. Rear controls remain schematic/photo-based approximate positions; package heights are not asserted.
46 mm rounded enclosure, 22.5 mm depth, centred square display and three top controls are coherent. Internal board geometry remains explicit UNKNOWN; enclosure ports are not fabricated.
Native CAD retains PCB, full component layout, four spacers, glass and USB/side connector geometry. Framebuffer fills the documented active area without overlapping the outer black border.
